training_recipe.batch_size_source: Part E benchmark of v0.4 (reference default 128; halved only on OOM)
training_recipe.evaluation: sliding windows of 250 samples, stride 125 (window starts [0, 125, 250, 375, 500, 625, 750]); per-record probability = mean over windows
training_recipe.epochs_note: fixed for every development and final run; the one-cycle schedule spans all 50 epochs; no epoch selection, no early stopping, no checkpoint selection
training_recipe.loss: BCEWithLogits over 5 superclasses (NORM, MI, STTC, CD, HYP)

normalization: per-lead mean/std from training folds only
tuning_note: learning rate is the only tuned hyperparameter -- nothing else is tuned
selection_rule: Only the learning rate is tuned. lr is chosen ONLY by the fold-9 macro-AUROC, computed once at the end of epoch 50, of the signal_plus_physio arm, seed 42, per architecture; the chosen lr is applied IDENTICALLY to signal_only and signal_plus_all. No setting may be chosen, changed, or re-run based on the between-arm delta. The selected lr is recorded in a later write-once file before the final fold 1-9 run.
pipeline_sanity_gate: signal_only (resnet1d_wang, selected settings, seed 42) must reach fold-9 macro-AUROC >= 0.90 before any between-arm comparison is computed; if it fails, stop and debug, and report the failure -- do not tune further to pass it.
metadata_fusion: location: the metadata vector is concatenated to the network's global-pooled embedding (the 2*nf = 256-dim AdaptiveConcatPool1d [max, avg] output, after that embedding's BatchNorm1d + Dropout(0.25)) and the concatenation is the input of the head's first Linear (256 + meta_dim -> 128), followed by ReLU, BatchNorm1d(128), Dropout(0.5), Linear(128 -> 5); metadata enters RAW (age_imputed standardized with training-fold statistics, all other columns 0/1): no BatchNorm and no dropout is applied to the metadata; identical across arms: backbone, global pooling and the embedding's BatchNorm + Dropout (same seed -> identical initial weights, asserted in v0.4); differs across arms by design: only the input width of the head's first Linear (256 / 259 / 338 for signal_only / signal_plus_physio / signal_plus_all)
evaluation_aggregation_note: per-record probability = MEAN over sliding windows, chosen a priori; the reference implementation may use max -- stated deviation, not to be changed after results are seen
status: signal_only and all fold-9 comparisons are EXPLORATORY / development; only the week-8 fold-10 analysis is confirmatory.
self_sha256_procedure: Load the JSON file; remove the key 'self_sha256' (the key must be absent, not empty); serialize the remaining dict with json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')); compute SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes; the hex digest must equal the stored 'self_sha256'. (At write time numpy scalars were converted to plain JSON types first, so the loaded file hashes identically.)
